description.en: From ancient vision and optical devices through corpuscular, wave, and Fermatian accounts to Young’s interference, Fresnel’s diffraction, and polarization, tracing how the theory of light moved from rays to waves.

text.zh: 1. 早期光学理论：从远古到16世纪
text.en: 1. Early Theories of Light: From Prehistory to the Sixteenth Century

text.zh: 人类利用和认识光的历史始于远古。人们一面制造和改进光学器物，一面追问光的性质以及眼睛为什么能够看见，理论、实验、经验和技术在这一过程中交错发展。如图1(a)所示，早在约四千年前，人们已经制作铜镜，用经过磨光的金属表面映照面容[[1]](#ref-1)。
text.en: Humanity’s use of, and attempts to understand, light date back to prehistory. People made and improved optical devices while asking what light was and how the eye could see. Theory, experiment, practical experience, and technology became intertwined as these pursuits unfolded. As illustrated in Fig. 1(a), people were already making bronze mirrors some four thousand years ago, polishing metal surfaces to see their own reflections[[1]](#ref-1).

caption.en: FIG. 1. Early optical artifacts and light paths. (a) The back of a Qijia-culture bronze mirror, photographed at the National Museum of China. A knob sits at its center; the opposite face served as the reflecting surface[[2]](#ref-2). (b) Light paths cross at a pinhole to form an inverted image. (c) Reflecting the endpoint across the mirror unfolds the shortest reflected path into a straight line; dashed lines behind the mirror are construction lines. (d) The principle of Ptolemy’s refraction measurement: a graduated disk is half immersed in water, with the surface passing through its center $O$. The observer sights an underwater mark through the center and reads the angles that the paths on either side of the surface make with the normal. Arrows indicate the modern convention for the direction of light propagation. Panels (b)–(d) are geometric schematics, not historical drawings or measured data.

text.zh: 古代留下的文字，也记录了对影子、倒像和水中物体的观察：
text.en: Ancient writings also preserve observations of shadows, inverted images, and objects in water:

items.zh: **小孔成像。** 《墨子·经说下》写道：“足蔽下光，故成景於上；首蔽上光，故成景於下”[[3]](#ref-3)。这里的“景”指像。这段话讨论上下颠倒的成像关系：用现代光路表示，脚部反射的光穿过小孔后到达屏的上方，头部反射的光则到达下方，于是形成倒像，如图1(b)所示[[4]](#ref-4)。
items.en: **Pinhole imaging.** The *Mozi*, in “Explanations of the Canons, Part II,” states (our translation): “The feet block the light below, so the image forms above; the head blocks the light above, so the image forms below”[[3]](#ref-3). The passage concerns the inversion of the image: in a modern ray diagram, light reflected from the feet passes through the pinhole to the upper part of the screen, while light from the head reaches the lower part, producing the inverted image shown in Fig. 1(b)[[4]](#ref-4).

items.zh: **镜面反射。** 希罗（Hero of Alexandria）用最短路程解释平面镜的反射规律：在起点和终点固定时，比较经过镜面不同位置的折线路径。如图1(c)所示，把终点 $B$ 对称地移到镜后的 $B'$，经过镜面任一点的两段路程之和都保持不变。连接起点 $A$ 与 $B'$ 的直线与镜面交于 $P$，于是经过 $P$ 的路径最短，由此得到入射角等于反射角[5, §2.1]。
items.en: **Mirror reflection.** Hero explained reflection from a plane mirror by comparing the lengths of paths joining two fixed endpoints through different points on the mirror. In Fig. 1(c), reflecting the endpoint $B$ across the mirror to $B'$ leaves the total length of each two-segment path unchanged. The straight line from the starting point $A$ to $B'$ meets the mirror at $P$, so the path through $P$ is the shortest. This construction gives equal angles of incidence and reflection[5, §2.1].

items.zh: **折射。** 柏拉图（Plato）在《理想国》中提及物体部分浸入水中后看似弯折的现象；托勒密（Claudius Ptolemy）则进一步测量入射角和折射角，并将结果列成表[6, §1.2]。图1(d)展示了空气与水之间的测量方法：把带角度刻度的铜圆盘竖直放入水中，使水面经过圆心，再从空气中经圆心观察水下圆周上的标记。标记的位置确定水中那段光路，观察方向确定空气中的光路，因而可以读出两段光路相对法线的角度。改变对准方向与标记位置，就能比较不同角度之间的对应关系[5, §1.1]。
items.en: **Refraction.** In the *Republic*, Plato noted that objects partly immersed in water appear bent. Ptolemy went further, measuring angles of incidence and refraction and tabulating the results[6, §1.2]. Fig. 1(d) shows the method for air and water: a bronze disk with angular graduations is placed vertically in water, with the surface passing through its center. From the air, the observer sights a mark on the submerged circumference through the center. The position of the mark fixes the underwater path, while the viewing direction fixes the path in air, allowing both angles to be read relative to the normal. Changing the sighting direction and the position of the mark reveals how the two angles vary together[5, §1.1].

text.zh: 今天我们知道，光在视网膜上成像，经感光细胞和大脑的处理形成视觉[[7]](#ref-7)。古人却常把光的传播、眼睛的感知与心灵的认识放在一起讨论。一方面，有人认为物体不断发出“影像”，进入眼睛使人看见；相反地，也有人把视觉比作伸手触物，认为眼睛向外发出某种作用来感知物体[5, §1.1]。若眼睛能发光，为什么黑暗中仍看不见？柏拉图的解释为这种疑问留下了余地：眼内之火必须与外界日光结合，才能参与视觉[5, §1.1]。
text.en: Today we know that light forms an image on the retina, and that processing by photoreceptors and the brain gives rise to vision[[7]](#ref-7). Ancient thinkers, however, often discussed the propagation of light, the eye’s perception, and the mind’s understanding together. Some held that objects continually gave off “images” that entered the eyes and made sight possible. Others, by contrast, likened seeing to reaching out and touching, proposing that the eyes sent something outward to perceive objects[5, §1.1]. If the eyes could emit light, why could they not see in darkness? Plato’s account made room for this difficulty: the fire within the eyes had to join with daylight before it could contribute to vision[5, §1.1].

text.zh: “看见”也涉及注意与心志。《荀子·劝学》说“目不能两视而明，耳不能两听而聪”[[8]](#ref-8)。这句话强调，即使眼前有物，注意不能专一，也难以清楚觉察，体现了古人对心的活动与感知之间关系的认识。
text.en: Seeing also involves attention and the state of mind. The *Xunzi*, in “Encouraging Learning,” says (our translation): “The eyes cannot look at two things at once and see clearly; the ears cannot listen to two things at once and hear distinctly”[[8]](#ref-8). The point is that even when something is before our eyes, we may not perceive it clearly without focused attention—a reflection of how ancient thinkers understood the relation between the mind’s activity and perception.

text.zh: 随着观察范围扩大，人们希望看清远处的物体和天体，也希望辨清肉眼难以分辨的细节。17世纪的望远镜和显微镜把这些要求变成了具体的技术问题，并逐渐展示出从天体到昆虫、细胞的新景象[9, ch. 9, §2]。要改进这些仪器，就必须更准确地预测光在各个界面怎样偏折、不同透镜怎样共同成像。与此同时，反射、折射和颜色等现象，也不断要求人们解释光的物理性质[6, §1.3]。
text.en: As the range of observation widened, people sought clearer views of distant objects and celestial bodies, as well as details too small for the unaided eye to distinguish. In the seventeenth century, telescopes and microscopes turned these aims into concrete technical problems, gradually opening up new realms of observation, from celestial bodies to insects and cells [9, ch. 9, §2]. Improving these instruments required more accurate predictions of how light bends at each interface and how lenses work together to form images. At the same time, reflection, refraction, and color continued to call for an explanation of the physical nature of light[6, §1.3].

Consider light of a fixed color passing from uniform, isotropic air (medium 1) into water (medium 2). Let the angles of incidence $\theta_1$ and refraction $\theta_2$ be measured from the interface normal. As the nonzero angle of incidence is varied and the refracted angle recorded, the ratio of their sines remains constant:

text.zh: 空气入水时，观察到 $\theta_2<\theta_1$，所以 $K>1$，上式要求 $u_2>u_1$：这个模型预言光在水中更快[5, §3.5]。
text.en: On entering water from air, observation gives $\theta_2<\theta_1$, and hence $K>1$. The equation therefore requires $u_2>u_1$: this model predicts that light travels faster in water[5, §3.5].

text.zh: **惠更斯（Christiaan Huygens）的波动解释：** 假设光以波传播，波前上的每一点都会发出次波，经过一段时间后，共同贴住这些次波的包络构成新的波前。在这里的各向同性介质中，传播方向垂直于波前。图2(b)可以按下面的顺序构造。
text.en: **Huygens’s wave explanation.** Huygens assumed that light propagates as a wave and that every point on a wavefront emits a secondary wavelet. After a period of time, the envelope tangent to all these secondary wavelets forms a new wavefront. In these isotropic media, the direction of propagation is perpendicular to the wavefront. Fig. 2(b) can be constructed in the following order.

text.zh: 先在水面上选定两个点 $A,B$：入射的平面波前先到达 $A$，再沿水面扫到 $B$。把这两次到达之间的时间记为 $\Delta t$；它由入射波的方向、空气中的波速和 $AB$ 的长度决定，不能另外任取。设空气和水中的波速分别为 $v_1,v_2$。从波前刚到达 $A$ 的时刻起计时，经过 $\Delta t$，由 $A$ 发出的水中次波扩展到半径 $v_2\Delta t$。因此先以 $A$ 为圆心，在水下画出这个半径的圆弧。
text.en: First select two points $A$ and $B$ on the water surface: the incident plane wavefront reaches $A$ first, then sweeps along the surface to $B$. Let the time between these two arrivals be $\Delta t$; it is determined by the direction of the incident wave, the wave speed in air, and the length $AB$, and cannot be chosen independently. Let the wave speeds in air and water be $v_1$ and $v_2$. Measuring from the moment the wavefront has just reached $A$, after $\Delta t$ the wavelet emitted into the water from $A$ has expanded to a radius $v_2\Delta t$. Therefore, first draw in the water an arc centered at $A$ with this radius.

text.zh: 此时入射波前恰好到达 $B$，$B$ 处的次波才开始发出。从 $B$ 向水中的圆弧作切线，切点记为 $D$，于是 $AD=v_2\Delta t$，且 $AD\perp BD$。$A$ 与 $B$ 之间各点发出的次波，传播时间介于 $\Delta t$ 与零之间，它们也都与这条线相切；因此 $BD$ 就是这一时刻的折射波前。
text.en: At this moment the incident wavefront has just reached $B$, and $B$ has only just begun to emit a wavelet. Draw a tangent from $B$ to the arc in the water and call the point of tangency $D$; then $AD=v_2\Delta t$, and $AD\perp BD$. The wavelets emitted by the points between $A$ and $B$ have travel times between $0$ and $\Delta t$, and they are also tangent to this line; therefore $BD$ is the refracted wavefront at this moment.

text.zh: 再从 $B$ 沿入射光的传播方向反向量取距离 $v_1\Delta t$，找到空气中的出发点 $C$。由 $C$ 出发的波经过同一段时间恰好到达 $B$，所以在初始时刻，$C$ 与 $A$ 位于同一波前上，连线 $AC$ 就是原来的入射波前。于是 $CB=v_1\Delta t$，并且 $AC\perp CB$。
text.en: Next, from $B$ measure off a distance $v_1\Delta t$ backward along the propagation direction of the incident light, to find the starting point $C$ in air. The wave starting from $C$ reaches $B$ after exactly the same interval, so at the initial moment $C$ and $A$ lie on the same wavefront, and the line $AC$ is the original incident wavefront. Thus $CB=v_1\Delta t$, and $AC\perp CB$.

text.zh: 到这里，两个直角三角形才都确定下来：$ACB$ 在 $C$ 处为直角，$ADB$ 在切点 $D$ 处为直角，它们共用斜边 $AB$。入射波前 $AC$ 与水面的夹角，等于入射方向与法线的夹角 $\theta_1$；折射波前 $BD$ 与水面的夹角同理为 $\theta_2$。分别写出正弦，再相除消去 $AB$ 和 $\Delta t$：

The angle between the incident wavefront $AC$ and the water surface equals the angle between the incident direction and the normal, $\theta_1$; the angle between the refracted wavefront $BD$ and the water surface is likewise $\theta_2$. text.en: Again, $\theta_2<\theta_1$ for light entering water from air, so $K>1$ and therefore $v_25, §§2.3, 3.5].

text.zh: **费马（Pierre de Fermat）原理：** 费马以最短传播时间解释光路。更一般地，费马原理要求固定端点之间的传播时间取驻值，即路径发生微小改变时，传播时间的一阶变化为零；在这里均匀、无色散介质的平面界面问题中，驻值路径恰好是唯一的极小值路径。改变光穿过界面的位置，并对总时间求极小值，就能得到折射方向。如图2(c)，取界面为 $y=0$，固定空气中的起点 $A=(0,a)$ 和水中的终点 $B=(L,-b)$，其中 $a,b,L>0$ 都是给定的长度。在界面上任取一点 $P=(x,0)$，连接 $AP$ 和 $PB$，就得到一条候选光路。由于每种介质均匀，光在各自介质内沿直线传播；因此端点固定后，选定 $P$ 就确定了整条折线路径。$P$ 只能沿界面移动，所以它的横坐标 $x$ 是决定路径的唯一变量，尚未预先取定。图中的灰色折线表示选择另一界面交点时得到的路径。
text.en: **Fermat’s principle.** Fermat explained light paths in terms of least travel time. More generally, Fermat’s principle states that the travel time between fixed endpoints is stationary: its first-order change vanishes under small variations of the path. In the present geometry—a plane interface between uniform, nondispersive media—the stationary path is the unique minimum. Varying the point where light crosses the interface and minimizing the total time therefore gives the direction of refraction. In Fig. 2(c), take the interface to be $y=0$, and fix the starting point in air at $A=(0,a)$ and the endpoint in water at $B=(L,-b)$, where $a,b,L>0$ are given lengths. Choose any point $P=(x,0)$ on the interface and join $A$ to $P$ and $P$ to $B$ to obtain a candidate path. Because each medium is uniform, light travels in a straight line within it. Thus, with the endpoints fixed, choosing $P$ specifies the entire broken-line path. Since $P$ can move only along the interface, its horizontal coordinate $x$ is the path’s sole variable; it has not been fixed in advance. The gray broken line shows the path obtained by choosing a different crossing point.

text.zh: 因为空气入水时 $K>1$，这也要求 $v_25, §2.1]。本例中 $T''(x)>0$，且 $T'(0)<0$、$T'(L)>0$，因此驻点确实是区间内唯一的最小值。
text.en: Since $K>1$ for light entering water from air, this also requires $v_25, §2.1]. In this example, $T''(x)>0$, while $T'(0)<0$ and $T'(L)>0$, so the stationary point is indeed the unique minimum in the interval.

text.zh: 三种推导都能给出相同的角度规律，却对空气与水中的速度次序作出不同预测：微粒模型要求水中更快，惠更斯的波前构造与费马原理则要求水中更慢。当时尚无足以裁决这一速度分歧的空气和水中的光速比较结果[5, §§2.3, 3.5]。
text.en: All three derivations give the same angular law, yet they predict different predictions for the relative speeds of light in air and water. The corpuscular model requires light to travel faster in water, whereas Huygens’s wavefront construction and Fermat’s principle require it to travel more slowly. At the time, no comparison of the speed of light in air and water was available to settle this disagreement[5, §§2.3, 3.5].

text.zh: 前面的折射讨论固定了一种颜色。如果让白色的日光通过棱镜，屏上出现的却是一条展开的彩色色带：折射不仅改变了光的方向，还使不同颜色出现在不同位置。这些颜色是棱镜改变光后产生的，还是白光原本就包含的成分？牛顿通过选取色带中的一部分再次折射，再将分开的颜色重新汇合，检验这两种解释[9, ch. 9, §4]。
text.en: The refraction discussion so far has kept the color fixed. But when white sunlight passes through a prism, an extended band of colors appears on a screen: refraction changes not only the direction of light but also where each color appears. Does the prism create these colors, or are they already components of white light? Newton tested these alternatives by refracting a selected part of the spectrum again and then bringing the separated colors back together [9, ch. 9, §4].

items.en: **Separation into colors.** Sunlight passes through a narrow aperture and the first prism onto a screen, where an elongated band appears. The colors fall at different positions, showing how the prism spreads white light into a spectrum.

text.zh: **选色并再次折射。**
text.en: **Selecting a color and refracting it again.**

items.zh: 在色带前放置带窄孔的遮板，选取同一窄色段送入第二枚棱镜；它再次折射后仍是一束窄光，没有重新展开成完整色带。
items.en: A screen with a narrow aperture is placed in front of the spectrum to select a narrow band and send it through a second prism. After refraction, it remains a narrow beam rather than spreading into the full spectrum again.

items.zh: 固定选色孔和第二枚棱镜 $P_2$，转动第一枚棱镜 $P_1$，让不同色段依次通过同一孔；红端偏折较小、紫端较大，显示各色段的折射性质不同。
items.en: Keep the selection aperture and second prism $P_2$ fixed, and rotate the first prism $P_1$ so that different color bands pass through the same aperture in turn. The red end is deviated less and the violet end more, showing that the different bands have different refractive properties.

items.zh: **重组。** 让分开的颜色重新汇合，得到白光；这一结果与分色实验相呼应。
items.en: **Recombination.** Bring the separated colors back together to obtain white light, complementing the separation experiment.

text.zh: 这些操作表明，白光由折射性质不同的颜色成分组成。
text.en: These experiments show that white light consists of color components with different refractive properties.

text.zh: 棱镜将白光中的不同颜色分开，但即使只取其中一种颜色，光在薄膜中反射时仍会出现新的图样：一圈圈明暗相间的牛顿环（Newton’s rings），如图4(a)的模拟所示。如图4(b)所示，将平凸透镜的凸面放在平玻璃板上，两者之间形成从接触点向外逐渐增厚的空气隙；用单色光照明，在反射光中就会看到一圈圈明暗环[5, §3.5]。
text.en: A prism separates the colors in white light, but even light of a single color can produce a new pattern when reflected from a thin film: alternating bright and dark concentric rings, known as Newton’s rings, as simulated in Fig. 4(a). As shown in Fig. 4(b), placing the convex surface of a plano-convex lens on a flat glass plate creates an air gap that thickens outward from the point of contact. Under monochromatic illumination, concentric bright and dark rings appear in the reflected light[5, §3.5].

text.zh: 空气隙连续增厚，反射光却反复增强、减弱。怎样提出一个理论，解释这种周期性，并将环纹的位置与光的颜色、薄膜厚度联系起来？
text.en: As the air gap thickens continuously, the reflected light repeatedly grows brighter and dimmer. What theory could explain this periodic pattern and relate the ring positions to the color of light and the film thickness?

text.zh: 薄膜让同一种颜色的光出现交替明暗，而在晶体中，同一种颜色的光还可能分成两路。如图5(a)所示，透过一块方解石（calcite）看纸上的文字，会看到两个错开的像；即使用单色光，也会出现这种双折射（birefringence）。1669年，巴特尔森（Erasmus Bartholin）报告了这一现象，惠更斯后来用波前构造解释了两束光的折射方向。再加上一块晶体，却出现了这个解释尚未解决的问题[5, §2.3]。
text.en: A thin film produces alternating brightness and darkness in light of a single color, while a crystal can split light of that same color into two beams. As shown in Fig. 5(a), looking through a piece of calcite at printed text reveals two displaced images; this birefringence occurs even with monochromatic light. Erasmus Bartholin reported the phenomenon in 1669, and Huygens later used a wavefront construction to explain the directions in which the two beams refract. Adding a second crystal, however, raises a question that this explanation did not resolve[5, §2.3].

text.zh: 让单色光通过第一块方解石，用遮板挡住分出的其中一路，只让另一路进入第二块晶体。图5(b)比较这同一路光在第二块晶体两种取向下的结果。保持入射方向不变，绕这一路光的传播方向转动第二块晶体：在某些相对取向下，屏上只有一个光斑；在一般取向下，则出现两个光斑。第一块晶体分出的光，经过第二块时是否再次分束，取决于两块晶体的相对取向[5, §2.3]。
text.en: Send monochromatic light through the first calcite crystal, block one of the two emerging beams, and allow the other to enter a second crystal. Fig. 5(b) compares what happens to this same beam for two orientations of the second crystal. Keeping the incident direction fixed, rotate the second crystal about the beam’s direction of propagation. At certain relative orientations, only one spot appears on the screen; at most other orientations, two spots appear. Whether the beam emerging from the first crystal splits again in the second therefore depends on the crystals’ relative orientation[5, §2.3].

text.zh: 惠更斯的理论能够确定单块晶体中的两种折射方向，却尚未解释第二块晶体为何会作出这种与取向有关的选择。要继续解释这个实验，需要描述光通过第一块晶体后获得了什么性质，以及这种性质怎样影响后续传播。这种与取向有关的性质，后来被纳入偏振（polarization）的研究[5, §2.3]。
text.en: Huygens’s theory can determine the two directions of refraction in a single crystal, but it does not explain why the second crystal produces this orientation-dependent outcome. To account for the experiment, one must describe what property light acquires on passing through the first crystal and how that property affects its subsequent propagation. This orientation-dependent property later became part of the study of polarization[5, §2.3].

text.zh: 这些解释上的困难也不限于薄膜和晶体。即使只让光经过一个小孔或障碍物，阴影边缘附近也会出现条纹，而非简单光路所预期的锐利边界。这类现象称为衍射（diffraction）。格里马尔迪（Francesco Maria Grimaldi）在1665年刊行的遗著中记载，日光经小孔照亮窄物体后，远处屏上的阴影边缘出现彩色亮暗纹，几何阴影内部也有条纹；他还以水流绕过障碍后的起伏作类比[5, §2.2]。
text.en: These explanatory difficulties are not confined to thin films and crystals. Even when light passes only through a small aperture or around an obstacle, fringes appear near the edge of the shadow instead of the sharp boundary predicted by simple ray paths. This phenomenon is called diffraction. In a posthumously published work from 1665, Francesco Maria Grimaldi reported that sunlight passing through an aperture to illuminate a narrow object produced colored bright and dark bands at the edge of its shadow on a distant screen, as well as fringes within the geometrical shadow. He also compared this effect with ripples in water flowing around an obstacle[5, §2.2].

text.zh: 图6给出一个现代例子：激光通过狭缝后，屏上形成中央较亮、两侧明暗交替的条纹。理论需要进一步说明，孔或障碍物的形状和大小怎样决定这些明暗的位置。
text.en: Fig. 6 shows a modern example: after laser light passes through a slit, a bright central fringe and alternating bright and dark fringes appear on the screen to either side. A theory must further explain how the shape and size of an aperture or obstacle determine the positions of these bright and dark regions.

text.zh: 因此，关于光的本性的理论，除了给出正确的反射、折射方向，还要解释这些实验：光为什么在一些位置增强、在另一些位置减弱，通过晶体后又为什么对取向变得敏感？微粒说与波动说对同一折射光路的解释，至此需要接受更广泛的检验。接下来，先从明暗变化入手，考察两部分光到达同一位置时会发生什么[5, §§2.2–2.3, 3.5]。
text.en: A theory of the nature of light must therefore do more than give the correct directions of reflection and refraction; it must also explain these experiments. Why is light enhanced at some positions and weakened at others? Why does its behavior after passing through a crystal become sensitive to orientation? The corpuscular and wave explanations of the same refracted ray must now face a broader range of tests. We begin with the changes in brightness and ask what happens when two portions of light arrive at the same point[5, §§2.2–2.3, 3.5].

text.zh: 3. 波动光学的建立：19世纪初
text.en: 3. The Establishment of Wave Optics: The Early Nineteenth Century

text.zh: 上一节看到的薄膜明暗，为托马斯·杨（Thomas Young）提供了线索：反射光来自薄膜的两个界面，从第二个界面返回的光多走一段路，两部分光便有了传播时间差。杨意识到，这个时间差可能决定它们相遇后的强弱，并把它与声学中的拍联系起来——两个音调相近的音叠加时，声音会忽强忽弱。他由此写出一条“普遍规律”：同一束光的两部分经不同路径、沿相同或几乎相同的方向到达眼睛时，颜色的出现和消失取决于路径长度之差；在同一介质中，路径差为某一长度的整数倍时，同一颜色重复出现[5, §5.1]。
text.en: The bright and dark bands of thin films seen in the previous section gave Thomas Young a clue: the reflected light comes from the two interfaces of the film, and the part returning from the second interface travels an extra distance, so the two parts acquire a relative time delay. Young realized that this time difference might determine how strong they are after they meet, and he connected it with beats in acoustics—when two tones of nearly equal pitch are superposed, the sound grows alternately loud and faint. From this he wrote down a “universal law”: when two parts of the same beam of light reach the eye by different paths along the same or nearly the same direction, the appearance and disappearance of a color depend on the difference in path length; in the same medium, when the path difference is an integer multiple of a certain length, the same color reappears [5, §5.1].

The time average here means integrating the square of the disturbance over one period and then dividing by the period $T=2\pi/\omega$. For any time-independent phase $\alpha$, using $\cos^2 u=(1+\cos 2u)/2$, one has

&=\frac12+\frac{\sin(2\omega T+2\alpha)-\sin(2\alpha)}{4\omega T}\\
&=\frac12.
\end{aligned}

text.zh: 在近轴区域 $r_0\simeq L$，通常用 $L\gg a^2/\lambda$ 表示这个远场条件，所得图样称为夫琅禾费（Fraunhofer）衍射；也可以借助透镜，在焦平面观察这样的图样。若屏较近，二次相位不能忽略，条纹就属于菲涅耳（Fresnel）衍射，需要保留它重新计算[6, §§10.1.2, 10.2.1]。

If the screen is closer, the quadratic phase cannot be neglected, and the pattern lies in the Fresnel diffraction regime, requiring that term to be retained in the calculation[6, §§10.1.2, 10.2.1].

text.zh: 前面用 $\psi$ 表示振动的大小，计算了两部分光怎样增强或抵消。但一个振动除了大小，还可以有方向。先把两个方向分清：**传播方向**是波形向哪里前进，**振动方向**是在固定位置上，描述光的扰动沿哪个方向来回变化。对于横波，振动方向垂直于传播方向。
text.en: Above, $\psi$ was used to denote the magnitude of the vibration, and we calculated how two portions of light reinforce or cancel. But a vibration can have a direction as well as a magnitude. First distinguish two directions: the **direction of propagation** is the direction in which the waveform advances, while the **direction of vibration** describes, at a fixed position, the direction along which the light's disturbance oscillates back and forth. For a transverse wave, the direction of vibration is perpendicular to the direction of propagation.

text.zh: 例如，让光沿 $+z$ 方向传播，在垂直于 $z$ 的平面内选取互相垂直的 $x,y$ 轴。一束光的扰动可以只沿 $x$ 方向往复，另一束则只沿 $y$ 方向往复；两束光可以具有相同的频率、波长和强度，也朝同一个方向传播，但振动方向不同。如果一束光在固定位置的振动始终沿同一条直线，即使振动的正负随时间改变，这条直线的方向仍保持不变，就称为**线偏振光**。偏振描述的是这种振动方向及其随时间变化的方式，这里先讨论方向固定的线偏振[6, §§8.1–8.2]。
text.en: For example, let light propagate along $+z$, and choose mutually perpendicular $x$ and $y$ axes in the plane perpendicular to $z$. The disturbance of one beam may oscillate only along $x$, and that of another only along $y$; the two beams may have the same frequency, wavelength, and intensity and may travel in the same direction, yet have different directions of vibration. If at a fixed position the vibration of a beam always lies along the same straight line, then even though the sign of the vibration changes with time, the direction of that line remains fixed; such light is called **linearly polarized light**. Polarization describes this direction of vibration and how it changes with time; here we first discuss linear polarization with a fixed direction[6, §§8.1–8.2].

text.zh: 余弦描述振动的大小和正负，单位矢量 $\hat{\mathbf x}$、$\hat{\mathbf y}$ 则指定振动所在的直线。图11(b)的光沿 $x$ 振动，因此在 $y$ 方向上的分量为零；图11(c)反过来。振动也可以沿两轴之间的斜方向，此时在 $x,y$ 两个方向上都有分量。这两个方向是一组描述振动的坐标，并不是说每束光都同时含有两个独立振动。
text.en: The cosine describes the magnitude and sign of the vibration, while the unit vectors $\hat{\mathbf x}$ and $\hat{\mathbf y}$ specify the line on which the vibration lies. The light in Fig. 11(b) vibrates along $x$, so its component along $y$ is zero; Fig. 11(c) is the reverse. A vibration may also lie along an oblique direction between the two axes, in which case it has components along both $x$ and $y$. These two directions are a set of coordinates for describing the vibration; this does not mean that every beam simultaneously contains two independent vibrations.

text.zh: 现在回到图5(b)的实验。第一块方解石把光分成两路，遮板选出其中一路，得到具有固定振动方向的线偏振光。第二块晶体则把入射振动沿它所允许的两个正交偏振方向分解，并使两个分量沿不同光路出射。转动第二块晶体，就是转动这两个分解方向：入射光的振动方向不变，它在两个方向上的投影却会改变，因此两个光斑的强弱也会改变[5, §§2.3, 5.3; 6, §8.4]。
text.en: Now return to the experiment of Fig. 5(b). The first calcite crystal splits the light into two beams, and a mask selects one of them, yielding linearly polarized light with a fixed direction of vibration. The second crystal resolves the incident vibration along the two orthogonal polarization directions it permits and sends the two components out along different paths. Rotating the second crystal means rotating these two orthogonal polarization directions: the direction of vibration of the incident light is unchanged, but its projections onto the two directions change, so the brightnesses of the two spots also change[5, §§2.3, 5.3; 6, §8.4].

text.en: Let the incident vibration be $\boldsymbol\psi=A\hat{\mathbf p}\cos\chi$, where $A$ is the amplitude and $\chi$ is the time-varying phase. Substituting this decomposition gives

text.en: Thus the amplitude coefficients of the two channels are $A\cos\alpha$ and $A\sin\alpha$, i.e., the first-path component and the second-path component labeled in the formula above. The crystal sends the two components along separate paths, forming two spots at different positions on the screen. Using $\langle\cos^2\chi\rangle_t=1/2$ obtained earlier, compute the intensities separately:

text.zh: 这里 $I_{\rm in}$ 是进入第二块晶体的光强，$I_1,I_2$ 是两路出射光的光强。二者之和为 $I_{\rm in}(\cos^2\alpha+\sin^2\alpha)=I_{\rm in}$；转动晶体改变的是光在两路之间的分配。菲涅耳在处理双折射与偏振干涉时，正是用这种余弦、正弦的振幅分解来计算强度[5, §5.3; 6, §8.4]。
text.en: Here $I_{\rm in}$ is the intensity entering the second crystal, and $I_1,I_2$ are the intensities of the two emerging beams. Their sum is $I_{\rm in}(\cos^2\alpha+\sin^2\alpha)=I_{\rm in}$; rotating the crystal changes only how the light is divided between the two paths. In treating birefringence and polarization interference, Fresnel used precisely this cosine-and-sine amplitude resolution to calculate intensities[5, §5.3; 6, §8.4].

items.zh: **$\alpha=0$：入射振动沿第一个偏振方向。** 此时 $I_1=I_{\rm in}$、$I_2=0$，屏上只有第一路光斑。转到 $\alpha=\pi/2$ 时，$I_1=0$、$I_2=I_{\rm in}$，只剩第二路光斑。
items.en: **$\alpha=0$: the incident vibration is along the first polarization direction.** Here $I_1=I_{\rm in}$ and $I_2=0$, so only the first-path spot appears on the screen. Rotating to $\alpha=\pi/2$ gives $I_1=0$ and $I_2=I_{\rm in}$, leaving only the second-path spot.

items.zh: **$\alpha=\pi/4$：入射振动与两个方向各成 $45^\circ$。** 因为 $\cos^2(\pi/4)=\sin^2(\pi/4)=1/2$，所以 $I_1=I_2=I_{\rm in}/2$，两斑等亮。
items.en: **$\alpha=\pi/4$: the incident vibration makes $45^\circ$ with each of the two directions.** Since $\cos^2(\pi/4)=\sin^2(\pi/4)=1/2$, we have $I_1=I_2=I_{\rm in}/2$, so the two spots are equally bright.

items.zh: **其余一般取向。** 两个投影都不为零，屏上出现两个光斑，强弱随角度连续变化。这就解释了图5(b)中由单斑变成双斑的现象；单斑时，另一路消失是因为入射振动在那个方向上没有分量。
items.en: **Other orientations.** Neither projection is zero, so two spots appear on the screen, with their brightnesses varying continuously with the angle. This explains the change from one spot to two in Fig. 5(b); when only one spot appears, the other output has zero intensity because the incident vibration has no component along that direction.

text.zh: 这种方向模型还解释了偏振与干涉之间的联系。菲涅耳与阿拉戈发现，具有稳定相位关系的两束光，即使到达同一位置，若偏振方向互相垂直，也不出现通常的干涉条纹；将它们投影到同一检偏轴上后，条纹又能出现[5, §5.3]。在振动的矢量描述中，原因很直接：设两束光的振动分别为 $\boldsymbol\psi_1=\hat{\mathbf e}_1\psi_1$、$\boldsymbol\psi_2=\hat{\mathbf e}_2\psi_2$，其中 $\psi_1,\psi_2$ 是各自带符号的振动大小，则
text.en: This direction model also explains the connection between polarization and interference. Fresnel and Arago found that two beams with a stable phase relation do not show the usual interference fringes even when they reach the same position, if their polarization directions are mutually perpendicular; after they are projected onto a common analyzer axis, the fringes reappear[5, §5.3]. In the vector description of vibration the reason is straightforward: let the vibrations of the two beams be $\boldsymbol\psi_1=\hat{\mathbf e}_1\psi_1$ and $\boldsymbol\psi_2=\hat{\mathbf e}_2\psi_2$, where $\psi_1,\psi_2$ are their respective signed vibration magnitudes; then

text.zh: 相互垂直时，干涉项在求时间平均之前就已经为零，光强只剩 $I_1+I_2$。若沿与两方向都不垂直的共同方向取投影，两个投影分量便可以相加，干涉项重新出现。双晶体的取向效应和这些偏振干涉现象，共同推动了光是横向振动的解释：在垂直于传播的平面内，振动能够具有不同方向；若振动只沿传播方向，就没有这样的自由度[5, §5.3]。
text.en: When they are mutually perpendicular, the interference term already vanishes before time averaging, leaving an intensity of only $I_1+I_2$. If the vibrations are projected onto a common direction that is not perpendicular to either, the two projected components can add and the interference term reappears. The orientation effect of the two crystals and these polarization-interference phenomena together drove the interpretation that light vibrates transversely: in the plane perpendicular to propagation, the vibration can have different directions; if the vibration were only along the direction of propagation, no such freedom would exist[5, §5.3].

text.zh: 至此，波动理论的成功不只在于把光说成一种波。同一套叠加规则给出了双缝条纹的位置、薄膜亮暗与厚度的关系、单缝中央亮纹的宽度；再把振动方向纳入描述，又解释了双晶体对取向的选择和正交偏振光不干涉的现象。然而，相位、振幅和方向都能算出以后，仍有一个物理问题：究竟是什么在振动？当时声波、水波等熟悉的波都有承载振动的介质，光又能穿过抽去空气的空间，因而人们设想空间中还充满一种不同于空气的介质——以太[6, §1.4]。
text.en: At this point the success of the wave theory lay not only in calling light a wave. The same superposition rules gave the positions of the double-slit fringes, the relation between the brightness of a thin film and its thickness, and the width of the central bright fringe of a single slit; incorporating the direction of vibration then explained the orientation dependence in the two-crystal experiment and the non-interference of orthogonally polarized light. Yet once the phase, amplitude, and direction could all be calculated, a physical question remained: what exactly is vibrating? At the time, familiar waves such as sound waves and water waves all had a medium that carried the vibration, and light could pass through evacuated space, so people imagined that space was still filled with a medium different from air—the ether[6, §1.4].

text.zh: 偏振使以太的要求变得更加苛刻。传递横向振动需要介质在受到剪切形变后产生恢复力，普通流体却不能像弹性固体那样维持这种形变。以太既要能够传递横波，又要让天体穿行其中而不受明显阻碍。菲涅耳尝试让它对微小振动表现出弹性，对较大的位移又近似流体；这样可以容纳部分光学规律，却没有给出一个令人满意的机械解释[5, §5.3]。
text.en: Polarization made the requirements on the ether even more demanding. Transmitting a transverse vibration requires a medium that develops a restoring force after a shear deformation, whereas an ordinary fluid cannot maintain such a deformation as an elastic solid does. The ether had to transmit transverse waves while allowing celestial bodies to move through it without noticeable obstruction. Fresnel tried to make it behave elastically for small vibrations and approximately like a fluid for larger displacements; this could reproduce some of the known optical laws but did not yield a satisfactory mechanical explanation[5, §5.3].

text.zh: 波动理论解释了光怎样叠加、怎样振动，却仍未说明承载这些振动的介质究竟是什么。1845年，法拉第发现磁场能够改变光的偏振方向，为光与电、磁之间的联系提供了实验线索[5, §6.2]。
text.en: The wave theory explained how light superposes and how it vibrates, but it still did not say what medium carries these vibrations. In 1845, Faraday discovered that a magnetic field can change the polarization direction of light, providing an experimental clue to a connection between light and electricity and magnetism[5, §6.2].
